description: This file implements auto-instrumentation for OpenTelemetry tracing, including tracer provider, tracer, span creation, attribute handling, event recording, and span limits. It integrates with eBPF for sampling decisions and supports context propagation and telemetry data marshaling.

classes.name: autoTracerProvider
classes.description: Implements the TracerProvider interface with embedded functionality for auto-instrumentation.

classes.name: autoTracer
classes.description: Implements the Tracer interface, responsible for starting spans and tracing logic.

classes.name: autoSpan
classes.description: Represents a span with methods for recording events, setting attributes, ending, and context management.

classes.name: spanLimits
classes.description: Holds configuration for span attribute, event, and link limits, initialized from environment variables.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a new span, asking eBPF for sampling decision and span context info.

methods.name: traces
methods.description: Creates telemetry traces and span data for a new span.

methods.name: SetStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the span with a code and message.

methods.name: SetAttributes
methods.description: Adds attributes to the span, respecting attribute limits.

methods.name: End
methods.description: Ends the span and marshals telemetry data.

methods.name: RecordError
methods.description: Records an error event with optional stack trace.

methods.name: AddEvent
methods.description: Adds an event to the span with attributes.

methods.name: AddLink
methods.description: Adds a link to another span.
